thread:
maria: Heads-up — joint webinar with NimbusCloud on May 12. Final rehearsal window this week. Need to lock speakers, demo fallback (hardware + cloud), and swag logistics.
chris: I'll confirm Dedicated pool reservations and a canary model variant for fallback. Question: do we want the hardware demo live, or prefer recorded + live Q&A as a fallback?
sandeep: EdgeBlade is shipping two accelerator nodes for the booth demo. For the webinar we should assume network flakiness — proposal: run the live infer on EdgeBlade for demo, but pre-deploy an identical container to our hosted sandbox as hot-standby.
jamie: I'll own speaker ops. Speaker slides due Wed EOB. I'll coordinate bios and ask speakers to join the 30m mic check Thu morning.
kevin-ops: Ops note: need an easy switch for streaming + a tested fallback endpoint. If live demo drops, we should seamlessly switch to a recorded clip + point to hosted sandbox link. Who can paste the run-of-show?
maria: run-of-show (rough):
```
00:00 - 00:05 host intro + partner intro
00:05 - 00:20 co-demo (EdgeBlade live demo)
00:20 - 00:30 live Q&A + slides (backup: recorded demo clip queued)
00:30 - 00:35 marketplace announcement blurb + CTA
00:35 - 00:40 closing + swag/voucher instructions
```
elena: Swag: Nimbus requested co-branded tee + sticker pack for booth. For webinar-only, propose 50 digital voucher codes for US attendees. Physical shipping: courier to booth (pick up day-of) OR pre-ship to conference warehouse. Which do we prefer?
sandeep: Courier pick-up day-of is cheaper and reduces customs risk for EU shipments. For webinar winners, digital voucher seems simplest.
chris: Important: marketplace listing timing — preference to have it 'publish' within 1 hour after webinar to avoid mismatch with live demo claims. If that can't be guaranteed, use 'coming soon' slide and announce dates instead. @maria please confirm L2 on timing with Nimbus marketing.
maria: will check with Nimbus marketing today. Action items: 1) @jamie consolidate speaker bios + slides (due Wed EOB). 2) @sandeep confirm EdgeBlade NAT/firewall + hot-standby container by Thu. 3) @chris provision canary model + coordinate marketplace publish window. 4) @kevin-ops prepare fallback endpoint and streaming switch, run smoke test. 5) @elena confirm swag courier vs warehouse by Fri.
jamie: Got it, consolidating now.
kevin-ops: I'll run smoke tests tomorrow 10:00 PST and post results here. Fallback endpoint quick test:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/fallback/generate -d '{"prompt":"edge demo test"}' | jq .
```
maria: perfect — please paste pass/fail and latency numbers. Also, we should prep a single-slide fallback announcement to display if we drop to recorded. I'll draft and share in the doc.
calendar-bot: Reminder: Rehearsal meeting scheduled Thu 09:30-10:00 (mic check) — invite sent to speakers.
elena: I'll confirm courier pricing and let you know if warehouse option makes sense.
maria: thanks everyone — small team sync Thu 09:45 after mic check. :tada:
